summary: oc adm must-gather collects resource definitions and logs from AAP on OpenShift into a directory. Log in with oc, then run oc adm must-gather --image=registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/aap-must-gather-rhel9 --dest-dir <dir>, optionally limited with -- /usr/bin/ns-gather <namespace>. Without registry.redhat.io access use oc adm inspect.
questions: How do I run must-gather for AAP on OpenShift?
How do I limit must-gather to one namespace?
Which image does AAP must-gather use?
What if must-gather cannot reach registry.redhat.io?

answer_card.title: Run must-gather for AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc login <openshift_url>
# whole cluster
oc adm must-gather \
  --image=registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/aap-must-gather-rhel9 \
  --dest-dir <dest_dir>
# one namespace
oc adm must-gather \
  --image=registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/aap-must-gather-rhel9 \
  --dest-dir <dest_dir> -- /usr/bin/ns-gather <namespace>
```
If the cluster can't reach registry.redhat.io, use `oc adm inspect` instead.
